title: History's prompt box vanishes when the selected image model takes no image: no Cue, no Stop, no model picker
description: Fabio live 2026-09-27 (MPI-941 Phase 3 test, 'Deepinfra model tests' project): in an image card's History the Prompt tool was greyed out, 'No prompt-driven ops available for this model', so he could not stop a running generation from the prompt box. Cause: MpiGroupHistoryBlock takes the gallery's selected image model (resolveActiveModel('image'), modelHelpers.js:90); when that model has no op that takes an image (likely a DeepInfra text-to-image model), _hasPromptOps() is false, the prompt box never mounts (_syncPromptToolDisabled ~1837), and Cue/Stop and the model picker live inside it: a dead end. Fix: image History offers only models that take an image, as video History already does with its i2v filter (_promptModelFilter ~311), falling back to the first eligible model. Verify: a desktop spec with a t2i-only image model selected shows the prompt box in History on the first eligible model; then live. Member of the MPI-941 umbrella (Phase 10).
